AgentClient.title: AgentClient
AgentClient.description: An AI client lilbee builds a config document for.

AgentSurface.title: AgentSurface
AgentSurface.description: A lilbee surface a client's config wires the client up to.

ChunkType.title: ChunkType
ChunkType.description:
Values for the ``chunk_type`` column.

    Documents ingest as ``RAW``, extracted tables as ``TABLE`` (when table
    extraction is on), and wiki pages written by the wiki producer as
    ``WIKI``. Callers filter with ``Store.search(chunk_type=...)``; a ``RAW``
    filter also covers table chunks, since both are document content.

ConfigFormat.title: ConfigFormat
ConfigFormat.description: The serialization the client's own config file is written in.

CrawlRenderMode.title: CrawlRenderMode
CrawlRenderMode.description: How a crawl fetches pages. ``http`` uses no browser; ``browser`` runs Chromium with JS.

removed.description: Names removed: indexed sources, files an ingestion failure held out, and registered root labels.

EngineBackend.title: EngineBackend
EngineBackend.description:
The compute backend the engine selected on this host.

    ``CPU`` and ``UNKNOWN`` are separate answers on purpose. An empty device list
    has two causes a client cannot tell apart: a host that has no usable GPU, and
    a host whose device probe never answered. Only the first is CPU. Reporting
    ``CPU`` for the second misidentifies a CUDA or Metal host in the diagnostics
    a user pastes into a bug report.

EntityKind.title: EntityKind
EntityKind.description: Whether an ``ExtractedEntity`` is a concept or a proper-noun entity.

FtsLanguage.title: FtsLanguage
FtsLanguage.description:
Snowball stemmer languages LanceDB's FTS accepts (lancedb.index.lang_mapping).

    Listed here so config validation does not import lancedb.

KeyStatus.title: KeyStatus
KeyStatus.description: Whether a hosted provider's API key is configured and accepted.

KvCacheType.title: KvCacheType
KvCacheType.description: KV cache element type. ``q8_0`` / ``q4_0`` require flash attention.

MemoryKind.title: MemoryKind
MemoryKind.description: Whether a memory is an always-injected preference or a similarity-recalled fact.

ModelCompat.title: ModelCompat
ModelCompat.description: Whether the bundled llama.cpp runtime supports a model's architecture.

ModelSource.title: ModelSource
ModelSource.description:
Where a model is stored.

    StrEnum (not Enum) so ``ModelSource.NATIVE == "native"`` is True at
    runtime. Pre-existing tests, JSON-decoded payloads from older clients,
    and server handler comparisons against bare strings keep working
    without an explicit ``.value`` lookup or enum import.

ProfileEffect.title: ProfileEffect
ProfileEffect.description: When a changed profile value takes effect.

ProfileFolder.title: ProfileFolder
ProfileFolder.description: A folder lilbee reads profiles from, highest precedence first.

ProfileStatus.title: ProfileStatus
ProfileStatus.description: How the applied profile's file compares with the copy recorded on apply.

ReasoningMode.title: ReasoningMode
ReasoningMode.description:
How a chat API surface presents a reasoning model's thinking.

    ``separate`` reports thinking in the wire format's own reasoning channel:
    ``reasoning_content`` on ``/v1/chat/completions``, a ``thinking`` block on
    ``/v1/messages``. ``inline`` presents thinking as ordinary answer text with
    the ``<think>`` markers stripped, for clients that never render the
    reasoning channel. ``off`` asks the model not to think, which only reaches
    the template on a locally served model; ``/v1/messages`` also drops
    thinking a model produces anyway, ``/v1/chat/completions`` still reports it
    in ``reasoning_content``.

SettingGroup.title: SettingGroup
SettingGroup.description: Logical bucket names rendered by ``/settings`` and ``settings_list``.

SettingSource.title: SettingSource
SettingSource.description: The layer that supplies a setting's effective value, highest precedence first.

TableWork.title: TableWork
TableWork.description: What an upgrade does to the table in progress, as the line words it.

UpgradePhase.title: UpgradePhase
UpgradePhase.description: Stage of a first open that upgrades the library's format.

WarningCode.title: WarningCode
WarningCode.description: Stable identifier for a degradation, so a client can branch on it.

WorkerRole.title: WorkerRole
WorkerRole.description: Inference role identifier; addresses one llama-server in the fleet.
